title: Telangana CM To Launch Distribution Of 1.05 Cr New PDS Ration Cards On Aug 15

blocks.content: Telangana will begin distributing 1.05 crore newly sanctioned laminated Public Distribution System ration cards from 15 August 2026. The state-level launch will take place at Sangareddy, and the programme will run across all 119 Assembly constituencies on Independence Day.

items: The Public Distribution System is one of India’s largest food subsidy delivery systems.
Ration cards are used to identify households eligible for subsidised foodgrains under welfare schemes.
QR codes are commonly used in public service delivery for quick digital verification.
